title: Profile & Security
description: Manage your account identity, display preferences, password, two-step verification, active sessions and organization memberships.

account.title: Account information
account.description: Your display name appears in the console, the audit trail and notifications.
account.name: Display name
account.emailHint: You cannot change your e-mail address yourself. Ask an organization administrator when it needs to change.
account.saveFailed: The name could not be saved

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language and theme of the console.
preferences.localHint: Preferences are stored in this browser and apply immediately.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a long, unique password for this account. Changing it signs out every other session.
password.policyNotMet: The password does not meet every rule yet
password.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one
password.changedDescription: Sessions on other devices were signed out. This session stays active.
password.failed: The password could not be changed
password.revokeHint: A long passphrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.

mfa.title: Two-step verification (MFA)
mfa.description: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app is required every time you sign in.
mfa.onTitle: Your account is protected by MFA
mfa.onText: Every sign-in needs your password and a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.offText: Add a second layer of security with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or any other TOTP app.
mfa.setupDescription: Connect an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to finish.

steps.install: Open an authenticator (TOTP) app on your phone.
steps.scan: Scan the QR code, or type the secret key manually.
steps.enter: Enter the 6-digit code the app displays.

mfa.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.manualDetails: Account {{account}} · issuer {{issuer}} · {{digits}} digits · changes every {{period}} seconds
mfa.codeHint: Codes change every 30 seconds; enter the one currently shown.
mfa.enabledDescription: From now on an authenticator code is required to sign in.
mfa.disableDescription: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.
mfa.disableWarning: Without MFA only your password protects the account. Do this only when you are about to enrol a new device.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account. Revoke any session you do not recognize.
sessions.revokeFailed: The session could not be revoked
sessions.emptyHint: Sessions appear here once you sign in from a device.
sessions.confirmDescription: That device is signed out and has to sign in again with the password.
sessions.confirmOthersDescription: {{count}} sessions on other devices are signed out. This session stays active.

memberships.title: Organization memberships
memberships.description: Your role in each organization. The active organization decides which data you see.
memberships.empty: Not a member of any organization
memberships.emptyHint: Ask an organization administrator to send an invitation to your e-mail address.

problems.INVALID_MFA_CODE: The code is invalid or was already used. Enter the latest code from your authenticator app.
problems.MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED: MFA is already enabled for this account.
problems.MFA_NOT_ENABLED: MFA is not enabled for this account.
problems.MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED: The MFA setup expired. Close the dialog and start again.
problems.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
problems.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: The session already ended or was revoked.
problems.NOT_A_MEMBER: You are not a member of that organization.
